title: Invoices dated a day early after November DST change
text: Hartline flagged three invoices dated a day early after the November DST change, and their AP team wants to know if any others are wrong. Load TW-90871 was delivered to their Newark DC at 00:30 EDT on Sunday 2026-11-01 (04:30 UTC). Monday's batch dated it 2026-10-31 with a due date of 2026-11-30, but it should be 2026-11-01 and due 2026-12-01. Invoice dates are set by `invoice_dates_for_batch` in `invoice_dates.py`.
